meta.title: The Survival of Sarah Rose — AI Voice Pack + RU localization
meta.description: Unofficial fan mod: the original English text fully voiced by 75+ AI-cloned voices — plus a complete Russian localization with Russian voice acting. Free, 18+.

hero.title: The Survival of Sarah Rose — AI voice pack
hero.subtitle: Unofficial fan mod: the original English text fully voiced — 75+ cloned voices with emotion-aware delivery for every line. A complete Russian localization is included as well.
hero.badgeFormat: Opus 24 kbps — pack is only ~1.7 GB
hero.ctaSteam: The Survival of Sarah Rose on Steam
hero.installHint: Requires a purchased copy of the game on Steam. Free, CC BY-NC 4.0.

features.title: What you get
features.translateText: A full translation of 68 254 lines — switch the game to Russian and play the whole story localized.
features.voiceText: Cloned voices for every character via CosyVoice3 — the original English text becomes fully voiced, with a parallel Russian voice version.
features.emotionText: Every line carries the narrator's state: anger, desire, whisper, sarcasm — not a monotone reading.
features.voicesText: Sarah, Narrator, King Orwell, Kate, Thomas, Varga and dozens of other characters.

demo.title: Hear it in action
demo.lead: Real in-game lines with AI voice acting: cloned voices, live emotions. Hit a line — and hear the result.

phrases.speaker: Sarah
phrases.text: It's always so quiet here. It feels wrong.

phrases.speaker: Thomas
phrases.text: Sarah...I try to put on this front of the perfect king. Even on the battlefield, I cover up my fears.

phrases.speaker: Carolyn
phrases.text: Aah, should I give up my secrets so easily to you?

phrases.speaker: Sarah
phrases.text: You're not asking me, I'm asking you...stay with me...please. Nobody else in this world has ever been so true a friend to me...more than a friend.

phrases.speaker: Garret
phrases.text: And as for the blood on your hands, what is a few drops more? Surely you don't mean to tell me that you have not killed others before?

phrases.speaker: Sarah
phrases.text: Each night when I touch myself, my only fantasies are memories of our encounters.

phrases.speaker: Narrator
phrases.text: When he would come to her, her heart ran fast in her chests. When he failed to show, she felt herself nearing to tears.

voice.title: Voice acting — complete
voice.total: 100% voiced — all 134 534 lines in both languages (finished 2026-10-18).
voice.missing: If a line has no voice file yet — the game just plays it silently (no errors, no crashes).

install.title: Installation
install.step1: Download the ZIP and unpack its contents into the game folder (Steam: C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\The Survival of Sarah Rose), replacing files
install.step2: Launch the game and choose the language in the mod settings (the badge in the top-right corner): English — the voiced original, Russian — the full localization with Russian voices
install.step3: Done. The first launch may be slightly slower — Ren'Py rebuilds its cache
install.note: Requires the game bought on Steam. The project is unofficial and not affiliated with the developers or publishers.
